limits: Each picture is independently zoomed. Left edges are not a synchronized start and image widths are not speedup ratios.
Rank1 Host scopes and associated device windows are far apart on the export axis. Rank1 screenshots focus the exact attributed device tasks, not the Host containment interval.
MC2 rank1 includes a native area selection with small margins; selected range width is not the exact device-span metric.
Other visible slices outside the attributed window or selection belong to other scopes and are not counted in iteration2.

Level0 contains no independent peer-send/recv timeline or usable HCCL operation sequence; no straggler or wait root cause is inferred.
Per-rank clock conversion metadata does not establish a Host/device or cross-device calibration error bound; raw endpoint differences are not dispatch latency.
